name: Solar Installation Timeline in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: How long does a solar system installation take in Los Angeles County from estimate to power-on?
mainEntity.text: How long does a solar system installation take in Los Angeles County from estimate to power-on?

acceptedAnswer.text: The physical installation of solar panels may take only a few days, but the full process is usually longer because of design, permitting, utility coordination, and inspection. After the site visit, the contractor typically creates a system design, submits permits, orders equipment, schedules installation, completes inspections, and then waits for utility permission to operate. In Los Angeles County, the timeline can vary by city, utility, roof complexity, and whether electrical upgrades are needed. Ask the installer for a realistic start-to-finish schedule, not just the rooftop installation date. Also ask what items could delay the project, such as panel availability, main panel upgrades, or HOA approvals. A good estimate should separate installation time from approval time.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline usually includes site evaluation, design, permitting, equipment ordering, installation, inspection, and utility approval. Simple projects can move faster, but the permitting and utility steps often take longer than the roof installation itself. Delays usually come from design changes, equipment availability, or inspection scheduling.
